description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gorakana, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530012
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel numbers, extents (hectares), servitude rights, and other encumbrances for various land parcels across different districts. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on title registration amendments rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
